cc:Work.dc:title: SPIKES: glucose spikes and dips over 14 days
cc:Work.dc:description: Repository synthetic demo generator extended to 14 days. SPIKES-AI detect_events, high-confidence spikes and dips. Lifestyle gauges independently simulated. Target band reference: https://doi.org/10.2337/dci19-0028.
